dispersion_note: These summaries describe variation across repeated partitions of one fixed, structured dataset. They are not population confidence intervals and do not establish real-world agronomic performance.

deployment.evidence_note: Track A and Track B provide the evaluation evidence. This artefact's training metrics are not performance evidence, and no independent confirmatory sample exists for it.

precedence: EXPERT_REVIEW if OOD or entropy >= E*
STRONG if p1 >= P* and margin >= M*

definitions.selective_accuracy: top-1 accuracy among observations assigned to that advisory category; never multiclass precision
definitions.error_capture_rate: model errors routed to expert review divided by all model errors
definitions.review_precision: model errors among expert-review cases divided by all expert-review cases
definitions.expert_trigger: mutually exclusive: ood_only, entropy_only, both; the three shares sum to 1 when expert review is non-empty and are null when it is empty

advisory_policy.dispersion_note: These summaries describe variation across repeated partitions of one fixed, structured dataset. They are not population confidence intervals and do not establish real-world agronomic performance.

shap_deployment_only.disclosure: SHAP values explain the base estimator, not the calibrated end-to-end probability. The calibration mapping renormalises across classes, so these values do not exactly decompose the calibrated probabilities.
shap_deployment_only.causal_disclaimer: SHAP describes what the model learned from this dataset. It is not evidence of an agronomic causal effect.

scope_limits: The target is a crop-suitability label, not observed yield, profit or farmer income.
This is an educational decision-support prototype, not production-ready agronomic advice.
Repeated evaluation estimates performance on this fixed dataset and does not establish performance for Indian farms.
